title: Ornamentum
description: this is a friendly building mod that adds decorative blocks to expand building palette while staying true to the game's original style.
body:
# Ornamentum ### *Expand your creativity.*

A growing collection of vanilla-friendly decorative blocks for builders.

---
## 🌿 Vanilla Friendly Every block is designed to blend naturally with Minecraft's original style, making your builds feel like a true extension of the base game. ## 🏗️ Made for Builders Perfect for castles, villages, fantasy worlds, interiors, cities, temples, ruins, and every other creative project.
--- ## ✨ Features - 🧱 Decorative building blocks - 🎨 Vanilla-inspired textures - 🌍 Works in Survival & Creative - 📦 More content planned in future updates --- ## ❤️ Why Ornamentum? Minecraft already provides a fantastic collection of blocks—but sometimes a build needs just a little more detail. **Ornamentum** expands the building palette with carefully designed decorative blocks that feel like they have always belonged in vanilla Minecraft. Whether you're constructing a cozy cottage, an enormous castle, a bustling city, or decorating your survival base, Ornamentum gives you more creative freedom without changing Minecraft's familiar look. ---
📖 Future Plans - More decorative block sets - Additional stone variants - Community suggestions
---
## 💬 Feedback Suggestions, ideas and bug reports are always welcome! Thank you for downloading **Ornamentum** ❤️
